observed_mechanisms.stable_pre_execution_operation_identity: The advance operation_receipt_id is deterministically derived before the native operation from plan fingerprint, run id, action=advance, and frozen assignment-plan id; the native result must echo it.
observed_mechanisms.immutable_paired_evidence: Each paired observation binds candidate arm, frozen case, trial index, baseline/treatment metrics, and realized randomized assignments. Duplicate arm/case/trial cells and assignment or metric mismatches fail validation.
observed_mechanisms.typed_content_identity: Hypothesis events carry SHA-256 fingerprints of validated serialized event content. Reusing an event_id for different content fails closed; exact replay is recognized.
observed_mechanisms.atomic_append_only_authority: The SQLite event log performs an immediate transaction covering idempotency lookup, expected-head check, event insertion, idempotency index insertion, and commit.
observed_mechanisms.derived_statistical_state: Canonical decisions are recomputed from the append-only paired observation history; persisted terminal decisions are accepted only when their fingerprint matches that canonical recomputation.
observed_mechanisms.anytime_valid_fixed_family_inference: Bounded confidence sequences support repeated looks. Family error is permanently allocated across the registered frozen candidate/guardrail family and removed arms do not refund it.
observed_mechanisms.retry_missing_cells_only: Workflow recovery projects already observed cells and appends only missing candidate cells for the frozen block; resource totals are projected from admitted evidence.
observed_mechanisms.explicit_iterate_to_gate_promotion: An iterate winner requires explicit promotion to a separate gate registration; tune and gate case sets are frozen and spend carries forward.
observed_mechanisms.decision_boundary_recovery_test: The public Rust test injects a failure at decision attestation after completion and verifies that a later advance appends the missing canonical decision rather than duplicating completed observations.

important_scope_limits.not_self_improvement_result: Harn is an adaptive-experiment/runtime mechanism, not evidence that an autonomous self-improving agent improves over time.
important_scope_limits.provider_exactly_once_unproven: Every repeated hypothesis operation request is intentionally sent to the native adapter. The core supplies a stable operation_receipt_id but does not itself prove provider-side idempotent execution or receipt reconciliation.
important_scope_limits.cross_registration_error_spending_absent: The anytime-valid and multiplicity contract is for one frozen registration/family. A durable statistical error/query budget spanning successive self-improvement registrations was not found.
important_scope_limits.gate_not_outer_test: The gate case set is deliberately consumed for promotion, so it is not an untouched final outer test.
important_scope_limits.fingerprint_scope: The event identity is a typed-content fingerprint. It should not be overstated as a proof of broad semantic equivalence canonicalization.
important_scope_limits.process_kill_scope: The released example demonstrates process-boundary recovery for a failure after completion/observation persistence. It does not prove exactly-once provider consumption when a process dies after remote evaluation but before the first observation event is durable.

closed: stable logical block identity before native evaluation
explicit promotion identity and frozen family error allocation
remaining: provider-side exactly-once or reconciled logical evaluation consumption
fully untouched outer test outside tune/gate/rollback/routing/stopping
complete long-horizon self-improvement proposal chronology and outcome evidence

falsification_plan: SIGKILL after native/provider evaluation but before the first observation append; recovery must prove one provider dispatch or reconcile the same stable receipt before any retry.
Reuse the same operation_receipt_id with a different provider request/config/evaluator digest; adapter must fail closed rather than treat it as replay.

SIGKILL after only a subset of candidate cells for one block are durable; recovery must append only missing cells, preserve the frozen assignment plan, and avoid duplicate evaluation/resource/statistical consumption.
Delete any materialized decision cache and recompute from the immutable ledger; recovered verdict and promoted artifact identity must equal the uninterrupted trace.
Start a new candidate registration after a prior promotion and verify that any claimed global risk/query budget cannot reset silently.
Instrument the outer test and prove zero queries from tuning, gate promotion, rollback, routing, stopping, or strategy reopening before the final evaluation.
exact_next_action: Search public Harn hosts/adapters and adjacent systems for a concrete hypothesis.operation implementation that binds operation_receipt_id plus request digest to provider-side idempotency or UNKNOWN-result reconciliation before dispatch/retry. If absent, search for another public adaptive/self-improvement system combining stable logical evaluation identity, provider receipt reconciliation, immutable paired evidence, and ledger-derived anytime-valid decisions. In parallel search for a durable cross-registration statistical spending ledger and a third untouched outer-test layer.
